comment: ANCHOR: UNPROTECTED_RESTING_STOP_LQ1390_20261109 — LQ-20261107-1390. A resting GTC stop (Schwab AWAITING_STOP_CONDITION, mapped to pending_activation) is protection: it drives the unprotected count and value, while broker_protected and the armed-only loss-at-stop figures are unchanged. The unprotected count covers positions >= $100 and the wide value sums every position; the split names which is which.
